description.en: A VS Code-style file explorer and editor for DeepSeek Harness Web: browse the current conversation's workspace in the sidebar, then edit files in the center column with a Monaco editor. Files open as tabs; Markdown preview, .abap syntax highlighting, and editor themes are supported.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness Web 的 VS Code 风格文件管理器与编辑器：在侧边栏浏览当前对话的工作区文件，在中间列用 Monaco 编辑器打开编辑。文件以页签切换，支持 Markdown 预览、.abap 语法高亮与编辑器主题。
